comparator.name: Global Responsibility and Leadership
comparator.sourceNotes: Current2026–2027 programme identity and21course records are byte-identical to the prior inspection. The dated scheme retains the named115EC and13five-credit elective slots, with six Energy/Ecology/Climate offerings in two tracks. Complete current choice/progression and applicable Planet/Politics transition rules remain unresolved. The2026-entry counsellor guide confirms the three GRL majors; the2025–2026 brochure and older regulations/accreditation findings remain historical context, not current allocation authority. The official central faculty-TER link leads to Campus Fryslân Downloads, which lists no current TER. The verified115EC subset is retained.
components: Entry requires completion of all foundation and Skills Lab courses. This 10 EC project brings students, academic supervisors and external partners together to frame a research question, analyse evidence and produce practical recommendations or another agreed output.
The minor semester can include an exchange, an internship or courses from another faculty.

The final 10 EC capstone combines supervised research (70%) with a personal and social-responsibility portfolio (30%). The portfolio develops across the degree; both parts count within the same 10 EC.

exception.reason: Groningen confirms the core courses, Living Lab, minor and capstone. The rules for choosing the remaining electives for students who entered in September 2026 still need confirmation.
exception.curriculumContext: The dated catalogue lists thirteen 5 EC elective slots. Groningen’s current programme page describes a revised choice of majors. The elective rules for the September 2026 cohort still need confirmation.

audience.programmeDescription: Global Responsibility and Leadership at Campus Fryslân studies sustainability, politics, behaviour and global health. Students develop research skills and use them in a project with a partner organisation.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Groningen now advertises the programme as Global Politics & Sustainability. This table shows the confirmed 2026–2027 Global Responsibility and Leadership components. A UCR comparison awaits confirmation of the elective and transition rules for this cohort.

curriculum.limitation: The degree is 180 EC. The 115 EC shown includes the minor, Living Lab and capstone. The catalogue lists another 65 EC in elective slots, whose choice rules for September 2026 entrants still need confirmation.
